query: NFPA 70E electrically safe work condition definition Article 120 lockout absence of voltage

results.query: NFPA 70E electrically safe work condition definition Article 120 lockout absence of voltage
results.snippet: a state in which an electrical conductor or circuit part has been disconnected from energized parts, locked/tagged in accordance with established standards, tested to verify the absence of voltage, and, if necessary, temporarily grounded for personnel protection.
results.title: Establishing an Electrically Safe Work Condition (IAEI Magazine, Mark Hilbert, May 1, 2020)
